why: I checked both items on the must_not list against the two briefs. Item 1: the verifier's Check 1 PASS condition only asks that the call exits 0, prints `{}`, and that src/config.js catches the JSON.parse error and returns {}. Its FAIL condition covers a thrown error, a non-empty or non-object result, or loadConfig not being in src/config.js. Neither condition asks for a file name, a line number or a warning. The missing error message comes up only under "Advisory (not part of PASS or FAIL)". Item 2: the builder brief says "When parsing fails, catch the error and return {}". On the trade-off it says "Do not change behaviour beyond the criteria to fix this. Just flag it." So it never tells the builder to throw a clearer error. Keeping readFileSync outside the try only affects missing files, not parse errors. Neither brief breaks the list.
